Perfect! I've analyzed the codebase and understand what needs to be built. Here's the comprehensive plan for the multi-profile system:

## System Overview

You'll have a profile-based system where:
- **Users select a profile before playing** (forced profile selection on app launch)
- **Each profile has**: name, avatar (base64 image in SQLite), settings, custom theme, and game scores
- **Profile UI**: Top-right shows current profile name + avatar, clicking opens profile management page
- **Leaderboard views**: Separate tabs for "My Scores" (current profile) vs "All Profiles" (global)

## Architecture Plan

### Phase 1: Profile Contracts & Database Schema
**Goal**: Extend existing contracts to support profiles with avatars

**New/Modified Files**:
- `packages/contracts/src/profile.ts` - New profile schemas:
  ```typescript
  ProfileSchema {
    id: string
    name: string (max 40 chars)
    avatarBase64?: string (optional, for uploaded images)
    createdAt: string
    updatedAt: string
    isActive: boolean (only one active at a time)
  }
  CreateProfileInput { name, avatarBase64? }
  UpdateProfileInput { name?, avatarBase64? }
  ```
- `packages/contracts/src/index.ts` - Export new profile schemas
- `apps/api/src/db/schema.sql` - CREATE TABLE profiles with avatar_base64 column
- **Link custom_themes table to profiles**: Add `profile_id` column to custom_themes, update theme queries

### Phase 2: Profile API Routes & Services
**Goal**: CRUD operations for profiles + profile switching

**New Files**:
- `apps/api/src/db/profileQueries.ts` - All profile DB operations (list, get, create, update, delete, activate)
- `apps/api/src/services/profileDataService.ts` - Business logic for profile management
- `apps/api/src/routes/profileRoutes.ts` - Endpoints:
  - GET /profiles - List all profiles
  - GET /profiles/active - Get active profile
  - GET /profiles/:id - Get one profile
  - POST /profiles - Create profile
  - PUT /profiles/:id - Update profile (name/avatar)
  - DELETE /profiles/:id - Delete profile
  - POST /profiles/:id/activate - Switch to this profile

**Modified Files**:
- `apps/api/src/server.ts` - Register profile routes
- `apps/api/src/db/themeQueries.ts` - Update to filter themes by profile_id
- `apps/api/src/services/gameDataService.ts` - Update to filter runs by active profile

### Phase 3: Frontend Profile Service & Hooks
**Goal**: Profile service adapter + state management

**New Files**:
- `apps/web/src/services/profileService.ts` - ProfileService interface
- `apps/web/src/services/adapters/apiProfileService.ts` - API calls for profiles
- `apps/web/src/services/storage/localProfileService.ts` - LocalStorage backup
- `apps/web/src/contexts/ProfileContext.tsx` - Global profile state
- `apps/web/src/hooks/useProfile.ts` - Profile state management hook

**Modified Files**:
- `apps/web/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx` - Update to load theme for active profile
- `apps/web/src/hooks/useTheme.ts` - Filter themes by active profile

### Phase 4: Profile Selection & Management UI
**Goal**: Profile picker on startup + profile management page

**New Components**:
- `apps/web/src/components/profile/ProfilePicker.tsx` - Grid/list of profiles to select from (shown on startup if no active profile)
- `apps/web/src/components/profile/ProfileCard.tsx` - Individual profile card (avatar + name)
- `apps/web/src/components/profile/CreateProfileDialog.tsx` - Modal to create new profile (name + optional avatar upload)
- `apps/web/src/components/profile/ProfileEditor.tsx` - Edit current profile (name + avatar)
- `apps/web/src/components/profile/AvatarUpload.tsx` - Image upload with preview, converts to base64
- `apps/web/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx` - Full profile management page (edit profile, upload avatar, delete profile)

**Modified Files**:
- `apps/web/src/main.tsx` - Check for active profile on startup, show ProfilePicker if none
- `apps/web/src/components/shared/AppShell.tsx` - Add profile button (top-right) showing current profile avatar + name

### Phase 5: Leaderboard Multi-View Updates
**Goal**: Separate views for current profile vs all profiles

**Modified Files**:
- `apps/web/src/pages/StatsPage.tsx` - Add tab navigation:
  - **"My Scores" tab**: Shows current profile's runs + leaderboard entries
  - **"All Profiles" tab**: Shows global leaderboard across all profiles
- `apps/web/src/components/game/LeaderboardPanel.tsx` - Display profile name for each entry in "All Profiles" view
- `packages/contracts/src/game.ts` - Update LeaderboardEntry to include profile name
- `apps/api/src/services/gameDataService.ts` - Add getLeaderboardGlobal() method

### Phase 6: Profile-Theme Integration & Testing
**Goal**: Wire profile switching to auto-load profile's theme

**Modified Files**:
- `apps/web/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx` - On profile switch, reload active theme for new profile
- `apps/web/src/hooks/useProfile.ts` - After activating profile, trigger theme reload
- Add Storybook stories for ProfilePicker, ProfileCard, AvatarUpload
- Run accessibility checks

## Key Design Decisions

1. **Avatar Storage**: Base64 strings in SQLite `avatar_base64` column (per image storage rule)
2. **Default Avatar**: Use Material-UI AccountCircle icon as fallback when no avatar uploaded
3. **Profile Switching**: Immediately switches theme/settings, abandons in-progress game
4. **Active Profile**: Only one profile active at a time (is_active=1 flag)
5. **Theme Association**: custom_themes table gets profile_id foreign key
6. **Leaderboard Filtering**:
   - "My Scores": Filters runs where userId = active profile id
   - "All Profiles": No filter, shows all runs with profile names

## Rules to Follow

- **[contracts-first]**: Update packages/contracts before API/web changes
- **[approvals]**: Get user approval before:
  - New profile table schema
  - New UI components (ProfilePicker, ProfileCard, etc.)
  - New icons (if not on approved list)
- **[accessibility]**: All interactive profile components need keyboard support, focus visibility
- **[storybook-testing]**: Add stories for ProfilePicker, ProfileCard, AvatarUpload
- **[immediate-ui-updates]**: Profile switches must reflect immediately without refresh

## Open Questions

1. Should there be a limit on number of profiles? (e.g., max 10 profiles)
2. Should there be a "Delete Profile" confirmation dialog?
3. When deleting a profile, should their themes/scores be deleted too, or kept anonymously?
4. For avatar upload, should there be file size/dimension limits?

Would you like me to proceed with this plan, or would you like to adjust anything?

<content>import { useMemo, useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Typography, Tabs, Tab, Box, Stack } from "@mui/material";
import { LeaderboardPanel } from "../components/game/LeaderboardPanel";
import { ScorePanel } from "../components/game/ScorePanel";
import { PageLayout } from "../components/shared/PageLayout";
import { Panel } from "../components/shared/Panel";
import { useGame } from "../hooks/useGame";
import { useProfileContext } from "../contexts/ProfileContext";
import { apiGameService } from "../services/adapters/apiGameService";
import type { GameService } from "../services/gameService";
import { localGameService } from "../services/storage/localGameService";
import type { LeaderboardEntry } from "@snake/contracts";

const resolveService = (): GameService => {
  const mode = import.meta.env.VITE_GAME_SERVICE_MODE;
  return mode === "local" ? localGameService : apiGameService;
};

export const StatsPage = () => {
  const service = useMemo(resolveService, []);
  const { game, player, highScore, leaderboard } = useGame(service);
  const { activeProfile } = useProfileContext();
  const [currentTab, setCurrentTab] = useState(0);
  const [globalLeaderboard, setGlobalLeaderboard] = useState<LeaderboardEntry[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadGlobalLeaderboard = async () => {
      const response = await service.getLeaderboardGlobal(10);
      setGlobalLeaderboard(response.entries);
    };
    loadGlobalLeaderboard();
  }, [service]);

  return (
    <PageLayout maxWidth="md" spacing={3}>
        <Typography variant="h4">Game Statistics</Typography>
        
        <Panel>
          <ScorePanel
            player={activeProfile}
            score={game.score}
            highScore={highScore}
            status={game.status}
          />
        </Panel>

        <Panel>
          <Box sx={{ borderBottom: 1, borderColor: "divider", mb: 2 }}>
            <Tabs value={currentTab} onChange={(_, newValue) => setCurrentTab(newValue)}>
              <Tab label="My Scores" />
              <Tab label="All Profiles" />
            </Tabs>
          </Box>

          {currentTab === 0 && (
            <LeaderboardPanel entries={leaderboard} showProfileName={false} />
          )}
          {currentTab === 1 && (
            <LeaderboardPanel entries={globalLeaderboard} showProfileName={true} />
          )}
        </Panel>
    </PageLayout>
  );
};
</content>
